title: One Month, 2,000 Reviews

pre.en: How many stars did the review right below the top one give?
pre.zh: 排第一的那条评价下面那条，打了几颗星？

intro: 单元的最后一课：上线一个月后，Chen 和 Hannah 在咖啡馆里读用户评价，一起复盘。这一课把本单元「说清目的、方式和步骤」的说法放在一次对话里：to do、so that、by doing、without / instead of doing、once、designed to、It's hard to …，读的时候一个个找出来。

sentences.en: Right, it's been one month since launch.
sentences.zh: 好，上线整整一个月了。
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: Twelve thousand downloads and a 4.6 rating so far.
sentences.zh: 目前一万两千次下载，评分 4.6。

sentences.en: My mum gave us five stars as soon as it came out.
sentences.zh: 我妈一上线就给了五星。

sentences.en: I booked this table to read the reviews without the whole office watching us.
sentences.zh: 我特意订了这张桌子，就是想安安静静把评价读一遍，不用全办公室都盯着。

sentences.en: Go on, then.
sentences.zh: 那你念吧。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: What are people saying about the offline sync?
sentences.zh: 大家对离线同步怎么说？

sentences.en: On the whole, it's gone down well with users.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，用户挺满意的。
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: Believe it or not, most people don't even mention it.
sentences.zh: 说来你可能不信，大多数人提都没提。

sentences.en: That means they take it for granted.
sentences.zh: 这说明他们已经觉得理所当然了。

sentences.en: That's the best review you can get for a feature designed to be invisible.
sentences.zh: 一个本来就设计成让人感觉不到的功能，这就是最好的评价了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: You pushed back on sharing in October.
sentences.zh: 十月份你反对先做分享。
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: And you made the right call by putting sync first.
sentences.zh: 把同步放在前面，这个决定你做对了。

sentences.en: I've been waiting nearly two months to hear that.
sentences.zh: 这句话我等了快两个月了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Don't get used to it.
sentences.zh: 美得你！
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: Let's move on to the one-star reviews.
sentences.zh: 我们接着看一星差评。

sentences.en: OK, I'm ready for the worst.
sentences.zh: 好，最坏的我都准备好了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Some people can't sign in with their old email address.
sentences.zh: 有些人用原来的邮箱登录不了。
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: We should have tested that more.
sentences.zh: 这个我们本该多测一测的。

sentences.en: One man says the app is too strict with him, because it reminds him about the bins every hour.
sentences.zh: 有个男的说这个 App 对他太严了，每小时都提醒他倒垃圾。

sentences.en: And lots of people say it's hard to switch chores with a flatmate.
sentences.zh: 还有很多人说，跟室友换家务太麻烦。

sentences.en: That's fair, we got that part wrong.
sentences.zh: 说得对，那一块我们没做好。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: The email problem can be fixed in a day.
sentences.zh: 邮箱的问题一天就能修好。

sentences.en: And we could add a button so that two people can trade a job in one tap.
sentences.zh: 我们还可以加个按钮，让两个人点一下就能换活儿。

sentences.en: I'll take that on board.
sentences.zh: 这个我记下了。
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: Once we've listed the top three requests, we can plan the next update.
sentences.zh: 等我们把呼声最高的三个需求列出来，就可以规划下一次更新了。

sentences.en: And a woman living with five flatmates took it for a test drive for a week.
sentences.zh: 还有，有个跟五个室友合租的女生拿它试用了一个星期。

sentences.en: She's already sent us twelve ideas.
sentences.zh: 她已经给我们发了十二条建议。

sentences.en: Twelve?
sentences.zh: 十二条？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Well, all those late nights were worth it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那些熬夜的晚上没白熬。

sentences.en: Can't complain.
sentences.zh: 挺好的，没什么可抱怨的。
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: Even Arjun sleeps through the night now.
sentences.zh: 连 Arjun 现在都能一觉睡到天亮了。

sentences.en: I'm going to order another coffee and wind down instead of opening my laptop.
sentences.zh: 我再点一杯咖啡放松一下，不开电脑了。

sentences.en: Wait, what's the top review?
sentences.zh: 等等，排第一的评价是什么？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Five stars: "Finally, my flatmates do their chores."
sentences.zh: 五星：「我的室友们终于肯做家务了。」
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: And the one right below it, from the same flat, one star: "This app has ruined my life."
sentences.zh: 就在它下面那条，来自同一套公寓，一星：「这个 App 毁了我的生活。」

cards.note: 也能当动词：launch an app；上线派对是 launch party。
动词 rate（打分）；应用商店里的「评分和评论」是 ratings and reviews。
used when you are talking about something in general, not about every detail
cards.tip: 放句首加逗号最常见；和 as a whole（作为一个整体）不一样。
cards.example: On the whole, the trip was a success.

cards.note: if something goes down well with people, they like it
cards.tip: 反过来是 go down badly with；完成时是 has gone down well。
cards.example: His speech went down well with the audience.

cards.zh: 信不信由你；说来你可能不信
cards.note: used before saying something surprising but true
直接接宾语，不说 mention about it。

cards.zh: 认为……理所当然（因而不在意）
cards.note: to not notice or value something because it is always there
in + visible；反义 visible。
to disagree with an idea or a plan and argue against it
cards.tip: 职场常用，语气比 disagree 委婉。
cards.example: Several managers pushed back on the plan to close the office.

cards.zh: 做出正确的决定；判断对了
cards.note: to make a good decision, especially a difficult one
cards.tip: call 在这里是「决定」；做错了是 make the wrong call；常说 It's your call（你来定）。
cards.example: Leaving early was the right call — the roads were empty.

cards.note: to stop thinking about something bad that happened and start thinking about other things
cards.tip: 第 80 课是「向前看」；开会时 Let's move on to … 是「我们接着说……」。
cards.example: Let's move on to the next point on the list.

cards.note: to type your name and password so that you can use a website or an app
cards.tip: 登录到哪里用 sign in to；用什么登录用 with：sign in with your email。
cards.example: I can never remember which email I used to sign in.

cards.note: to make someone follow rules and behave well, and not allow them to break the rules
to make a mistake about something, for example a time, a place or a fact
也能当动词：tap the button；英式 tap 还是「水龙头」。
to listen to an idea or a criticism and use it
cards.tip: 职场常用，表示「意见我听进去了」；sth 是代词时放中间：take it on board。
cards.example: Thanks for the feedback — we'll take it on board.

cards.note: 功能需求常说 feature requests；比 ask 正式。

cards.text: take sth for a test drive
cards.note: to drive a car before you buy it to see if you like it
if something is worth it, the good result is more important than the time, money or effort it cost
cards.tip: worth 后面直接接 it，不加 to；值得做某事是 be worth doing。
cards.example: The tickets were expensive, but the concert was worth it.

cards.zh: 还不错；没什么可抱怨的
cards.note: used to say that things are going well enough
cards.tip: 英式口语里回答 How are things? 的常见说法，省掉了主语 I，语气轻松、低调。

cards.note: to relax after a busy or exciting time, especially before sleep
夸张的口语里很常见：You've ruined the surprise!
